title: exact modular singular-ray atlas for the primitive E recurrence
proved: Every actual-prime divisibility of every linear factor of Q_0,Q_1,Q_2,Q_3 is classified.
The only infinite linear singular rays are s=2 in Q_1 through 4h+15, s=4 in Q_2 through 4h+27, and s=6 in Q_3 through 4h+39.
The finite actual linear singular rows are (h,s,p)=(1,1,13), (2,1,17), and (1,2,19), with all coefficient-factor occurrences recorded.
All possible p, 2p, and 3p multiples are audited; parity excludes 2p for slope-four factors, and 4h+35=3p at (1,1,13) is the sole quotient-three case.
For each core q_k, the exact actual-row congruence reduces to the primitive diagonal polynomial Rhat_k(s), with degrees (5,9,9,5).
The raw diagonal contents are (432,62208,139968,432), supported only at primes 2 and 3, hence units at every actual p>=13.
Rhat_0,Rhat_1,Rhat_2,Rhat_3 are irreducible over Q by exact irreducible reductions modulo 17,53,157,17 respectively.
The exact adjacent identity q_0(h)=q_3(h+3), equivalently Rhat_0(s)=Rhat_3(s-2), aligns trailing and next-cell leading core singularities.
For s>=7, the recurrence gives exact same-characteristic three-state transport on the actual diagonal; its companion determinant is -Q_0/Q_3.
On a regular finite diagonal interval, the unrestricted recurrence solution module is F_p^3 and a selected scalar zero is a dimension-two hyperplane of p^2 valid states.
complete_modular_criterion: For every actual row and each k, p divides Q_k(h) iff p divides a classified linear factor or p divides Rhat_k(s).

strict_scope.unrestricted_state_obstruction: The zero-hyperplane theorem concerns all valid recurrence states, not the pinned actual E initial orbit.
